About us

Hi, we're LumiWear.

We make comfortable everyday clothing with a little bit of light in it.

Our story

LumiWear was created for people who live their lives well past sunset — evening walks, late-night city trips, concerts and festivals. We wanted clothes that feel great all day and have a small surprise once the lights go down.

That surprise is our glowing star. Printed or stitched with glow-in-the-dark materials, it charges in daylight or under a lamp and softly lights up in the dark. No batteries, no wires — just a little magic.

What we stand for

Better materials

We use organic cotton and recycled polyester wherever we can, and we choose fabrics that last.

Small, focused collections

Fewer pieces, made with more care. We'd rather perfect one hoodie than release ten average ones.

Real, personal service

Every message is answered by a real person on our small team — usually within one working day.

Ready to find your glow?
